g.text: A four-second-only, independent prospective study. Own handover downtime resets the watchdog; scans pause its evidence counter.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516574

g.text: Native packet and action traces are descriptive diagnostics; registered statistical and engineering decisions remain in the primary figure.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Measured history-to-forecast issue work determines actual FIFO completion. Startup/loading is separate; shared +0.5 s is a scheduling assumption. Ordinary admission/scoring CPU is not separately scheduled.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: A move resets available silence to zero; delivery / association / own handover reset it, scans pause it. The full 4 s handover and 90 ms scan costs are paid.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Offline replay retains the original paid schedule; fresh-cost repetitions measure timing sensitivity without extra sites. Shared procedural CAD, finite trials and warm history do not establish physical reliability.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #bc4c5e

g.text: PRIOR AGGRESSIVE 4 s REPAIR FAILED DEVELOPMENT: RadioMap +5.505 pp · JEPA +4.748 pp. That result remains unchanged.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3278a5
